name: משוואת מעגל – מרכז נתון ונקודה על המעגל (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find the equation of the circle with centre \( ({{CT:0}},{{CT:1}})\) and which passes through \(({{CT:2}},{{CT:3}})\).

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
The equation of a circle with centre \((a,b)\) and radius \(r\) is \[ (x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2.\]

The centre is \( ({{CT:0}},{{CT:1}})\) the circle passes through \(({{CT:2}},{{CT:3}})\) so therefore the radius is \[ \sqrt{ ({{CT:0}}-{{CT:2}})^2 + ({{CT:1}}-{{CT:3}})^2} = {{CT:4}}.\]
Therefore the equation of the circle is \[ {{CT:5}}. \]
